title: Not quite what it should be.
text:
Not quite what it should be.. The product has a great look and feel. It’s fairly easy to use the components to assemble and disassemble.

The downside for me is that it doesn’t give direction or HOW to make the cold brew. The inner filter basket doesn’t touch the bottom of the carafe which means the coffee grounds won’t have even contact with the water inside. If you match water level with the grounds it ends up being too light in flavor.

****DO IT THIS WAY****
What I found to work is to pour in the water while the filter basket is seated properly. This allows less grounds to spill out and for easier pouring of water over the grounds. From there remove the filter from the lid and carefully set it in the brew water. It is wide enough that the filter basket won’t tip (but it can lean so be cautious not to fill grounds too far to the top).

description: Brew a distinctively smooth and perfectly balanced cup of Coffee at home with this 1 Qt. Cold brew Coffee maker. Cold brewing extracts the unique and delicious flavor compounds from your Coffee grounds. The process is simple but requires time and care to make the perfect cup of cold brewed coffee. The result is a great Cup of Coffee that’s 65% less acidic than traditional hot brewing methods. Brew your perfect cup by placing Coffee grounds in the fine mesh brew filter and soaking the grounds in room-temperature or cold water for 24 hours. Simply remove the filter and pour into your glass or over ice. The result is a smooth and refreshing cup of Coffee.
